blocks.title: Enable Link cloud billing for {organization}
blocks.purpose: Links your existing Ever Gauzy Cloud billing account to your Ever Platform organization, so all your plans show in one place. Prices, limits and existing offers do not change.

leaves_installation.purpose: Match the cloud tenant's billing customer to the organization's billing account

platform_keeps.retention: Kept while the integration is enabled.

blocks.where_to_change: Integrations & data in this product, or Instances in app.ever.co; turning it off stops the data at once.
blocks.revoke_effect: The link is removed. Billing itself continues unchanged.
blocks.authorisation: I am authorised to enable this for {organization}
